lines = [l.strip() for l in text.split("\n") if l.strip()]
# Remove header and category lines
skip = {"Scribe County Public Library","Title","Author","Publisher","Genre","Status","Books","Young Children's","Middle Grade","Young Adult"}
filtered = [l for l in lines if l not in skip]

# Group every 5 lines into a record: Title, Author, Publisher, Genre, Status

# Keep only well-formed records of 5 elements
records = [r for r in records if len(r) == 5]

not_on = riordan[riordan["Status"].str.lower().isin(["checked out","overdue"])]
print("Count not on shelves:", len(not_on))
print(not_on[["Title","Status"]])
